findings.claim: Signed favorable-minus-comparison endpoint contrasts at the observed selection nodes are strongest and most reproducible for the short-range pair-distance shells: pair_kernel_1.5 (endpoint_effects:9, integrated z 0.562, q 1.5e-4, positive batch fraction 1.0), pair_kernel_2.5 (endpoint_effects:10, z 0.631, q 2.2e-5, 1.0), pair_kernel_3.5 (endpoint_effects:11, z 0.540, q 9.8e-5, 1.0) and pair_kernel_5.0 (endpoint_effects:12, z 0.319, q 3.7e-3, 0.857), with the sign reversing at pair_kernel_7.0 (endpoint_effects:13, z -0.485, q 1.5e-4, positive batch fraction 0.0). The same features survive branch-level adjustment (branch_adjusted:163/164/240/241). These are selection-enrichment contrasts on a standardized coordinate observable, not an absolute geometric descriptor and not a physical interaction energy.

Landmark occupancy and softmin contrasts are internally inconsistent in sign across landmarks: occupancy3/occupancy5 are positive at landmark_00 (endpoint_effects:15 z 0.545, :16 z 0.208) and landmark_04 (endpoint_effects:28 z 0.300) but negative at landmark_02 (endpoint_effects:21 z -0.038, :22 z -0.323), landmark_03 (endpoint_effects:24 z -0.007, :25 z -0.395), landmark_05 (endpoint_effects:30 z -0.005, :31 z -0.344), landmark_06 (endpoint_effects:33 z -0.009, :34 z -0.365), landmark_15 (endpoint_effects:60 z -0.017, :61 z -0.357) and landmark_18 (endpoint_effects:69 z -0.058, :70 z -0.311). Softmin signs likewise disagree (positive at landmark_00 :14 is negative z -0.481; positive at landmark_02 :20 z 0.253, landmark_03 :23 z 0.360, landmark_05 :29 z 0.396, landmark_06 :32 z 0.294, landmark_15 :59 z 0.369, landmark_18 :68 z 0.264). Because the observable is a radial shell density that is not monotone in distance, no single landmark direction can be read as a shared quality axis.

The global shape tensor carries a coherent negative contrast on the yy component: shape_yy endpoint effect z -0.513 (endpoint_effects:4, q 1.5e-5, positive batch fraction 0.0), with shape_xx z -0.495 (endpoint_effects:3) and shape_yz z -0.212 (endpoint_effects:8); the branch-adjusted correlation for shape_yy is also negative (branch_adjusted:158, :235). The same sign recurs in the per-landmark local_cyy enrichment at every landmark (regional_effects:5,15,35,45,55,65,75,85,95,105,115,125,135,145,155,165,175,185,195), so the yy contrast is not merely a global-pose artifact. This is a coordinate covariance descriptor, not an inferred chemical mechanism.

Global centroid contrasts are weak and not reproducible: global_centroid_y endpoint effect z -0.243 (endpoint_effects:1, q 0.014) but global_centroid_x z -0.111 (endpoint_effects:0, q 0.257) and global_centroid_z z -0.061 (endpoint_effects:2, q 0.481); after branch adjustment the centroid effects are null (branch_adjusted:77-79, :231-233). Centroid translation therefore does not carry a supported signed direction in this evidence.

Descendant survival credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity: decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available is false and lineage_support states the multiple-testing scope is 'BH jointly over 400 survival field/measure tests; not terminal affinity effects'. The survival table shows only weak positive enrichment (e.g. landmark_00_soft_mass survival_effects:0 z 0.365, q 0.120; landmark_07_soft_mass :70 z 0.220, q 0.356; landmark_10_soft_mass :100 z 0.234, q 0.302; landmark_18_local_czz :186 z 0.217, q 0.302) alongside negative local_cyy/czz entries (:46 z 0.266 positive for local_czz but :56 z -0.419, :75 z -0.299, :96 z -0.390, :146 z -0.308, :156 z -0.399, :165 z -0.317, :195 z -0.294). The immediate selection contrast and the descendant survival credit disagree in sign for several local_cyy/czz features, so last-record credit must not be presented as final affinity benefit.

Parent-child increment contrasts and the turnover residual disagree with the population contrasts for the same features. Increment effects are significant for landmark_00_softmin (increment_effects:14, z -4.91, q 0.046), landmark_00_occupancy3 (:15, z 4.28, q 0.081), shape_xx (:3, z -3.70, q 0.095), shape_yy (:4, z -3.85, q 0.161), shape_xz (:7, z 3.00, q 0.207), pair_kernel_2.5 (:10, z 3.96, q 0.208), pair_kernel_7.0 (:13, z -3.14, q 0.208), landmark_03_occupancy5 (:25, z -3.02), landmark_06_occupancy5 (:34, z -2.87) and landmark_16_occupancy3 (:63, z -1.75). The turnover table shows large positive edge_rate and turnover_residual_rate for local_cxx/cyy/czz at many landmarks (e.g. turnover:14 z 4.29, :17 z 5.05, :47 z 6.40, :134 z 5.67, :224 z 5.08, :227 z 5.63, :254 z 5.54, :257 z 4.58, :497 z 6.37, :524 z 5.24, :527 z 4.51, :584 z 5.30, :587 z 5.37) with q as low as 0.0116. The turnover residual is an accounting diagnostic that mixes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not a causal selection effect or an atom velocity.

Joint diagnostics show that selection innovation is positively associated with native alignment (joint_diagnostics:1, mean 0.092, q 2.2e-9, positive batch fraction 1.0) and with teacher innovation-contrast alignment (:11, mean 0.226, q 2.2e-9, 1.0), while it is negatively associated with observed child score gain (:2, mean -0.036, q 1.8e-7, positive batch fraction 0.0). The teacher contrast is dominated by the internal fraction (:14, mean 0.787) rather than translation (:12) or rotation (:13), and atom participation is partial (:15, mean 0.384). The information audit reports compressed-choice excess fixed RMS 0.081 A (CI 0.070-0.092) and compressed chosen teacher score correlation 0.102 (CI 0.065-0.140), with the audit's own limitation that this is not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian.

Whole-window integrated contrasts are the appropriate stationary summary, and the supplied time variation is large: the observed-node linear fits for landmark_00 and landmark_01 features show first_rate_z and last_rate_z of opposite sign with many sign changes (e.g. continuous:1 first_rate_z -17.5, last_rate_z 8.1, 6 sign changes, 9 strong sign conflicts; continuous:2 -72.4 vs 5.5; continuous:7 64.8 vs -19.7; continuous:17 66.2 vs -22.9; continuous:19 -51.3 vs 19.3). curve_support reports relative node RMSE 0.30-0.99 and strong sign-conflict nodes up to 18, and legendre_runtime_allowed is false for every audited curve. No time-conditioned reward information is proposed; the whole-window integrated contrast is the stationary rule.

Joint-motion diagnostics are the most reproducible negative contrasts in the branch-adjusted table: joint_innovation_RMS_A (branch_adjusted:74 raw covariance z -5.2e-5, q 0.038; :151 adjusted covariance q 0.020; :228 raw correlation z -0.142, q 9.3e-5, positive batch fraction 1.0; :305 adjusted correlation q 2.8e-4, 0.929) and joint_internal_RMS_A (:76 q 0.044; :153 q 0.030; :230 q 1.5e-4, 1.0; :307 q 9.7e-4, 1.0), with joint_translation_RMS_A weaker (:75 q 0.095; :152 q 0.072; :229 q 0.087; :306 q 0.052). These are joint pose/shape diagnostics, not evidence of neural-module causation.

The short-range pair-kernel contrast is reproducible across independent batches and survives adjustment: branch_adjusted:86 (pair_kernel_1.5 adjusted covariance q 0.081, same-sign batch fraction 0.786), :87 (pair_kernel_2.5 q 0.077, 0.786), :240 (pair_kernel_1.5 adjusted correlation q 0.019, 0.929) and :241 (pair_kernel_2.5 q 0.046, 0.929), while pair_kernel_7.0 reverses (:244 q 0.129, negative). curve_support flags pair_kernel_1.5 and pair_kernel_2.5 among the audited curves with relative node RMSE 0.48 and 0.39 and strong sign-conflict nodes 7 and 5, so the direction is supported but the curve fidelity is imperfect.

Local coordinate information beyond common motion is concentrated in the local_cyy and local_cxx components: local_cyy enrichment is negative at every landmark (regional_effects:5,15,35,45,55,65,75,85,95,105,115,125,135,145,155,165,175,185,195) and the parent-edge contrast rate for local_cxx and local_cyy is strongly negative at every landmark (regional_effects:404,405,414,415,424,425,434,435,444,445,454,455,464,465,474,475,484,485,494,495,504,505,514,515,524,525,534,535,544,545,554,555,564,565,574,575,584,585,594,595), while soft_mass enrichment is positive at several landmarks (regional_effects:0 z 0.639, :22 local_dy z 0.405, :62 local_dy z 0.425, :92 local_dy z 0.325, :142 local_dy z 0.350, :182 local_dy z 0.425, :213 local_dz z 1.62, :249 local_cyz z 1.79, :283 local_dz z 1.70, :393 local_dz z 1.78). The surrounding coordinates that should retain freedom are the local_dx/dz and off-diagonal local_cxy/cxz/cyz components, which are mostly null or inconsistent.

Uncertainty and multiplicity-adjusted support change the ranking relative to point estimates alone: many landmark occupancy and softmin features have small point estimates but q values above 0.05 after BH adjustment (e.g. branch_adjusted:0-73 include q 0.13-0.98 for most landmark_00-19 occupancy3/occupancy5 and softmin entries), whereas the pair-kernel and joint-motion features retain q below 0.05 (branch_adjusted:86,87,151,153,228,230,240,241,305,307). A ranking by point estimate alone would over-prioritize landmark occupancy features that do not survive multiplicity adjustment.

hypotheses.claim: Testable coordinate intervention: observable is the short-range pair-distance shell density pair_kernel_1.5-5.0 at the observed selection nodes; intended response is a signed favorable-minus-comparison contrast increase in those shells with a simultaneous decrease in pair_kernel_7.0; target origin is the endpoint pointcloud coordinate reward; spatial scale is 1.5-5.0 A pair distance; temporal scale is the whole observed window [0.0,0.49]. Discriminating failure condition: if the pair_kernel_1.5-5.0 contrast does not increase while pair_kernel_7.0 decreases, or if the effect is not reproducible across independent batches, the hypothesis is falsified. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the endpoint pointcloud scalar with a region-bound landmark and pointcloud_delta_A in {0.5,1.0,2.0}; the pair-kernel term itself is diagnostic only and is not in the executing pointcloud scalar.

Testable coordinate intervention: observable is the local_cyy component of the regional covariance at each landmark; intended response is a signed favorable-minus-comparison contrast decrease in local_cyy; target origin is the endpoint pointcloud coordinate reward; spatial scale is the 5.0 A landmark radius; temporal scale is the whole observed window. Discriminating failure condition: if local_cyy contrast does not decrease at the targeted landmark while local_dx/dz and off-diagonal components remain free, or if the effect is explained by global shape_yy alone, the hypothesis is falsified. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the endpoint pointcloud scalar with a region-bound landmark; the regional moment term itself is diagnostic only.

Testable coordinate intervention: observable is the descendant survival enrichment at the observed selection nodes; intended response is a signed favorable-minus-comparison survival credit increase; target origin is the recorded joint-head credit; spatial scale is the landmark radius; temporal scale is the whole observed window. Discriminating failure condition: if the survival credit increase is accompanied by a turnover residual increase of the same sign, or if the effect disappears when parent weighting is accounted for, the hypothesis is falsified. Because decoded terminal labels are unavailable, this remains descriptive and cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

Testable coordinate intervention: observable is the joint innovation RMS and its alignment with the teacher contrast; intended response is a signed favorable-minus-comparison contrast increase in joint_innovation_RMS_A; target origin is the endpoint pointcloud coordinate reward; spatial scale is the joint pose/shape extent; temporal scale is the whole observed window. Discriminating failure condition: if joint_innovation_RMS_A does not increase while observed child score gain decreases, or if the effect is not reproducible across independent batches, the hypothesis is falsified. The joint-motion term itself is diagnostic only and is not in the executing pointcloud scalar.

Testable coordinate intervention: observable is the whole-window integrated contrast for a stationary coordinate rule; intended response is a signed favorable-minus-comparison contrast increase in the integrated contrast; target origin is the endpoint pointcloud coordinate reward; spatial scale is the landmark radius; temporal scale is the whole observed window. Discriminating failure condition: if the integrated contrast does not increase while the first_rate_z and last_rate_z remain of opposite sign, or if the effect requires time-conditioned reward information, the hypothesis is falsified. No time-conditioned reward information is proposed.

Testable coordinate intervention: observable is the multiplicity-adjusted support of landmark occupancy and softmin features; intended response is a signed favorable-minus-comparison contrast increase only for features whose q remains below 0.05 after BH adjustment; target origin is the endpoint pointcloud coordinate reward; spatial scale is the landmark radius; temporal scale is the whole observed window. Discriminating failure condition: if a feature's point estimate is large but its q exceeds 0.05, or if the effect is not reproducible across independent batches, the hypothesis is falsified.

limitations: Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity; decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available is false.
Turnover residual includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not only resampling.
Adjusted branch covariance is supplied evidence; region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals.
Curve fitting does not establish causal benefit or a gradient; no time bins or outside-window analysis.
Static teachers are last-learning-node forecasts, not actual final structures.
All weak and null scalar effects retained; current study outcomes are withheld from design roles.
The executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; those are diagnostic evidence only.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters and no temperature edit is proposed.
